reason: The compiled WASM's traverse_host::emit_event call declares core.action-item.status-transitioned, which violates traverse-contracts' own EventContract identity invariant (id must equal namespace + "." + name for that event) and is rejected outright by a strict EventRegistry::register load. State-machine transition logic itself is unaffected -- only the emitted event's declared id is wrong. See registry#324. Replaced by 1.4.0, which emits the corrected core.status-transitioned@1.0.0.
